subject: general
question: The Government of India signed a memorandum of agreement with the Nagaland government and the Eastern Nagaland People’s Organisation to form the __________ within the state.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Frontier Nagaland Territorial Authority.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **The Government of India signed a memorandum of agreement with the Nagaland government and ENPO to form the Frontier Nagaland Territorial Authority.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **The Frontier Nagaland Territorial Authority will grant legislative, executive, and financial autonomy to six eastern districts of Nagaland.**
 
• The arrangement is subject to review after a period of 10 years.
 
• ENPO represents several tribal communities from eastern Nagaland that have been demanding a separate state since 2010.
 
• In Nagaland’s 60-member legislative assembly, 20 members represent eastern Nagaland.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• Eastern Nagaland People’s Organisation__

 __
 
• ENPO is an apex body representing tribes from eastern Nagaland.
 
• It has been advocating for greater autonomy and development of the region.
 
 
 
• Frontier Nagaland Territorial Authority__
 __
 
• FNTA is a proposed autonomous authority within Nagaland.
 
• It aims to address developmental deficits in eastern Nagaland.
 
 
 
• Eastern Districts of Nagaland__
 __
 
• The six districts include Mon, Tuensang, Kiphire, Longleng, Noklak, and Shamator.
 
• These districts are home to multiple tribal communities.
 
 
 
• Legislative Assembly of Nagaland__
 
 
• The Nagaland Legislative Assembly has a total strength of 60 members.
 
• Eastern Nagaland accounts for one-third of the assembly representation.
